in_sanskrit.name: नीया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: She who leads, guides, inspires or attracts.

in_hindi.name: निया
in_hindi.meaning: नि: अगले, अधिक, अगले तरह से (Next, More, Further) + या: वह (She, That, That One)
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who comes next or more, or the one who leads or guides.

in_tamil.name: நீயா
in_tamil.meaning: நீ: நினைவு (Mind, Intention, Aim) + யா: அவ்வால் (She, That One)
in_tamil.long_meaning: She who has a mind or intention, or the one who leads or guides.

in_telugu.name: నీయా
in_telugu.meaning: నీ: నేటు (Intention, Purpose, Objective) + యా: అవ్వళ్లో (She, That One)
in_telugu.long_meaning: She who has an intention or purpose, or the one who leads or guides.

in_marathi.name: Nia
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nia हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nia means 'flow' or 'movement' in Sanskrit and is inspired by the flowing waters of a river or the graceful movements of a tree.
